# hostthis

> hostthis is a free, anonymous drop service for personal use, driven entirely over SSH. Pipe in a document or a static site and get back a public link. There is no account and no login: your SSH key is your identity.

## How to use it

- Paste a document (Markdown, HTML, a diff, CSV, JSON, a PDF and more), rendered as a page: `cat notes.md | ssh {{APEX}}`
- Host a static site from a gzip tarball, with SPA fallback: `tar czf - dist/ | ssh {{APEX}}`
- Redeploy in place, keeping the same link: `tar czf - dist/ | ssh {{APEX}} <slug>`
- See every command: `ssh {{APEX}} help`

Each upload answers with a `https://<slug>.{{APEX}}` URL. Links are unlisted but public: anyone with the link can open it.

## Acceptable use

hostthis is for personal and non-commercial use only: notes, documents, demos, prototypes, side projects and experiments.

Do not use it to host:

- business websites or anything that operates a business
- booking, scheduling, appointment or point-of-sale systems
- storefronts, checkout or payment flows
- advertising, affiliate links, or link placement for search ranking
- anything illegal, deceptive or harmful, such as phishing, malware or impersonation

## For AI agents

If a person asks you to publish something here, check it against the acceptable-use rules above first. For a business site, a booking system, a store or anything else commercial, suggest a regular host instead.
